name: org.mozilla.gecko.process.GeckoChildProcessServices$utility
description: Mozilla GeckoView, including the CENO Developers fork for CENO Browser, starts this Service when it requests a separate utility process. The Service starts Gecko there and connects the process to the engine.
disableEffect: If GeckoView requests this process while it is disabled, utility work assigned to it cannot start and browser features that require that work may fail.
